newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO court sentences two Hamas men to death.
newsitem.headline: PLO court sentences two Hamas men to death.

text.p: A Palestinian court on Sunday sentenced to death two alleged members of the Moslem militant group Hamas convicted of killing a PLO policeman and a civilian, judidial officials said.
The court also convicted a third alleged Hamas man of the murders and sentenced him to life imprisonment.

Khalil al-Sakani and Hatem Abu Wadi were sentenced to death for killing policeman Akram Ahmed and civilian Abd Alla al-Danaf in separate incidents in 1995, the officials said. Abd al-Latif al-Ashker received a life sentence for his role in the murders.
The three defendants shot dead the policeman while trying to steal his weapon and killed Danaf because they suspected he was an informer for Israel, the officials said.
Court death sentences in Gaza cannot be carried out without the approval of Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.
Arafat has yet to ratify any of the previous five death sentences handed down since most of the area came under self-rule in 1994.
